create_openai_gpt_config: create an OpenAIGPTConfig instance with default hyperparameters for the OpenAI GPT model
create_openai_gpt_config_custom: create an OpenAIGPTConfig with custom n_layer, n_embd, and n_head values for a smaller model
create_openai_gpt_model_from_config: initialize an OpenAIGPTModel with random weights from an OpenAIGPTConfig instance
access_model_config: access the model configuration via model.config after creating an OpenAIGPTModel
configure_summary_parameters: configure OpenAIGPTConfig summary_type, summary_activation, and summary_first_dropout for sequence classification
